allowed.claim: Naturally air-dried using no additives or preservatives.
Hypoallergenic, grain free and gluten free chews.
A healthy alternative to rawhide - fully digestible, never contains rawhide.
allowed.source: Boar product page and homepage FAQ

allowed.claim: Brewery Bites are upcycled from spent brewer's grain and made in the UK.

banned.claim: Calling any product 'sustainable' or 'eco-friendly' without qualification.
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim; use specific 'upcycled from spent brewer's grain' instead.

banned.claim: 'Zero impact' or 'carbon neutral' for Brewery Bites.
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unverifiable environmental claim with no stated backing.

banned.claim: 'Relieves your dog's tummy pain' or 'fixes digestive issues'.
banned.why: Medical claim not supported; stick to 'easily-digestible for sensitive tummies'.

banned.claim: 'Improves your dog's skin and coat' as a treatment claim.
banned.why: Health/medical claim; site says 'good for' - keep it general, not a promised outcome.

banned.claim: Presenting chews as a complete meal or nutritionally sufficient.
banned.why: Contradicts their own FAQ - chews are complementary and not sufficient as a single meal.
